dedupe_keys.name: annual rice paddy maps of madagascar at 10 m 2017 2025

description: Country-wide annual maps of rice paddies in Madagascar. The Zenodo record says nine annual 10 m GeoTIFFs for 2017 to 2025 were produced without ground labels, using the flooding-to-greenup signal in Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 series as pseudo-labels and classifying Google Satellite Embedding features with a two-stage random forest; classes are rice paddy, other crops, wetlands and other land. It reports 91.2 per cent overall accuracy and paddy area growth from 886,112 ha in 2017 to 1,195,766 ha in 2025, mostly around existing rice areas, with double cropping more common in the east. Files are free to download under CC BY 4.0 (about 270 to 290 MB per year, EPSG:3857), with an Earth Engine app. Coverage is Madagascar. Caveats: recall is lower than precision (83.2 per cent). For simulation it maps rice land exposed to cyclones, floods and drought, a staple food for the country. A related catalogue record is GlobalRice20.
